verdicts.reason: A keeps the T recognisable, with the stem centred under the bar and the headline intact. But the shrunken group sits off to the left and leaves the right ~45% of the canvas as dead blue space; the T no longer bleeds off the edges as in the original; and the white copy runs across the stem edge raggedly. B centres the group, which balances the space better, but it orphans 'NOW!' on its own line inside the red bar. The stem is pushed to the bar's right end, so the T reads as a Γ/L shape. The red block also clips oddly behind the white lines, which damages both the brand mark and the headline.
